<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I call out to you, my Elders, that you may hear my cry. Come to me!”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Jerri Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jerri is a woman from the ancestral homeland of [[Vandenyas]] who serves as a pilot, a role in which she navigates through dangerous environments by charting courses via the stars and monitoring various creatures or phenomena. She possesses tattoos consisting of [[Script|script]] that travel from her ankle up to her neck and shoulder. Jerri maintains a deep connection to an object known as her [[Vessel]]; being separated from it causes her significant distress, while holding it makes her feel powerful and complete. Throughout her journey, she acts as an ally to [[Calder]], even while navigating complex political or personal conflicts involving figures like [[Shera]]. Her experiences include being imprisoned in cells, surviving being spat out by the void onto an island in the [[Aion Sea]], and performing physical feats such as jumping between stories. She has also been involved in various high-stakes situations, ranging from navigating ships to facing potential death.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jerri has [[Script|script]] tattoos on her ankle, shoulder, neck, jawline, and hand. She wears emerald earrings that glint green in the moonlight and has been seen in a flawless golden dress as well as standard red prison clothing. When she rose from the [[Aion Sea]], she wore a blindfold of [[steel]] over her eyes.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A companion and wife to [[Calder]], Jerri is a person who makes her own choices and keeps her own secrets. She has shown enthusiasm for tasks, once struggling to suppress a grin, and has been known to reassure [[Calder]]. She is also described as being unimpressed with the [[Sleepless]] acolytes.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jerri is married to [[Calder]], serving as his companion and a member of his crew. She worked alongside him to gather information for a prison break involving his father and was ultimately killed by [[Shera]], who also kidnapped her. Additionally, Jerri studied with the [[Blackwatch]] under [[Alsa Grayweather]] and is mentioned by [[Dalton Foster]] and [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a [[Soulbound]], Jerri possesses a [[Vessel]] that she can control through contact and which communicates via her earring. She is capable of producing [[green flame]] from her hand and has performed an [[Elderspawn summoning ritual]] using her own blood. Additionally, she can use a pistol, a long knife, or a dagger, and has used alchemical resin to seal doors.}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jerri is distinguished by tattoos located along her jawline and the left side of her neck.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref> The daughter of a Watchman, she was brought to the [[Sleepless]] by her father during her childhood.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" /> She is an acquaintance of the members of [[Calder]]'s crew.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri's father]] was a Watchman.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Secret meeting-house}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|While kneeling in the damp basement of a secret meeting-house located in the Capital, Jerri struggled to suppress a grin due to excitement regarding the task at hand.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> Following a kidnapping by [[Shera]], Jerri ended up in prison for the betrayal of [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] is in prison for betraying [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] was kidnapped by [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Member of the group}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a member of the group, Jerri utilizes an earring to communicate with her [[Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref> An eager crew member ready to begin the dash, she carries both a pistol and a long knife.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref> While her earring flickers green, Jerri is able to control her [[Vessel]] through physical contact.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> She is remembered by [[Calder]], whom she once cradled with his head in her lap.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref> Jerri is a person mentioned by [[Dalton Foster]] and features spidery text tattoos along her neck, jawline, and leg.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ritual in the cells}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Jerri, formerly known by her maiden name Tessella, had observed something within the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> Having grown accustomed to spending time in cells, she performed an [[Elderspawn summoning ritual]] using her own blood.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" /> While her father believed the [[Great Elders]] represented a path to a better world, Jerri expected the resulting [[Elderspawn]] to cause chaos so that she might escape.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref> Ultimately, she is the individual who receives the [[Heart of Nakothi]] from the [[Great Ones|Great One]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] had seen something in the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] has grown used to spending time in cells.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]]'s maiden name is Tessella.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri's father]] believed the [[Great Elders]] were the path to a better world.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] performs an [[Elderspawn summoning ritual]] using her own blood.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] expected [[Elderspawn]] to cause chaos so she could escape.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] is a person who receives the [[Heart of Nakothi]] from the [[Great Ones|Great One]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Aion Sea descent}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Clad in a flawless golden dress, Jerri stood upon a deck alongside [[Calder]] and the [[Elder worms]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> She had risen from the [[Aion Sea]] wearing a blindfold of [[steel]] over her eyes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" /> During this time, [[Kelarac]] was inhabiting Jerri's body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref> It is possible that Jerri was holding back during the battle.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] is on a deck with [[Calder]] and [[Elder worms]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] rose from the [[Aion Sea]] with a blindfold of [[steel]] over her eyes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kelarac]] is inhabiting [[Jerri]]'s body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kelarac]] is in the body of [[Jerri]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Then how do we get the cell door open?” Jerri asked.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I call out to you, my Elders, that you may hear my cry. Come to me!”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“We have taken The Testament,” Jerri responded.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Kelarac is still free to act,” Jerri said.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Would you like me to kill her?” Jerri asked, suppressing her delight.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}
